title: Hull F.C.
extract: Hull Football Club, commonly referred to as Hull, Hull F.C., or the Airlie Birds, is a professional rugby league club based in Kingston upon Hull, East Riding of Yorkshire, England. The city of Hull is split in two by the River Hull with Hull F.C. representing the west side and cross-city rivals Hull Kingston Rovers representing the east side.
